program.appliesTo: All current and future TerraWest 4x4 locations
program.promise: We maintain a relationship with our customer and their vehicle for three years, helping ensure the build continues to work for their life, their destinations and what they want to do next.
program.designPrinciple: Technology manages the timing. The Build Consultant owns the relationship. The fitter owns the technical check. TWOS makes sure the promise is delivered.
program.changeNote: v1.1 follows the 4-11 September 2026 team review: first contact 24h -> 72h, the 3-month call removed, 18 months passive, the 10% voucher moved to 24 months at 6 months' validity, and 24-36 months ambient marketing only.

eligibility.trigger: GOLD AFTER-CARE tag applied at job finalisation (QJT-001 7A)
eligibility.dayZero: Job finalisation date, where the tag is present and the invoice is finalised
eligibility.minimumReference: Bull-bar installation scale/significance; consultant judgement applies
eligibility.restartRule: A later qualifying build on the same vehicle starts a new Day 0 and supersedes the earlier schedule without deleting vehicle history
eligibility.incompleteDayZeroRule: A job tagged AFTER-CARE without a finalisation date must not drive scheduled obligations (QJT-001 clause 34)

milestones.label: 72 hours
milestones.rule: Confirm satisfaction, function, understanding and concerns. No answer -> approved SMS, attempt recorded.
milestones.dueRule: Nearest business day where 72 hours lands on a weekend or public holiday

milestones.label: 1 month
milestones.rule: Fixed at 1 month. There is no km-based trigger or skip condition -- the milestone always occurs at 1 month regardless of any earlier suspension retorque (TWOS-AC-001 sections 4 and 5).

milestones.label: 6 months
milestones.rule: Morning preferred; allow customer 30 minutes; fitter allocation approximately 15 minutes; complimentary general inspection and coffee.
milestones.dueRule: Nearest business day at six months

milestones.label: 12 months
milestones.rule: Relationship-led physical check under the Build Health Check standard.
milestones.dueRule: Nearest business day at twelve months

milestones.label: 18 months
milestones.rule: No scheduled obligation. Raised only where vehicle history, an open concern or a recorded customer trigger warrants it.

milestones.label: 24 months
milestones.rule: Final active touchpoint. 10% voucher issued here, valid 6 months, not combinable with other offers.
milestones.dueRule: Nearest business day at twenty-four months

milestones.label: 24-36 months
milestones.rule: No consultant obligation generated. Customer remains in ordinary marketing contact, subject to do-not-contact and unresolved-issue suppression.
milestones.dueRule: Window from the 24-month milestone to cycle end

dailyWorkflow.delivery: TWOS presents due obligations to the accountable consultant each business morning; consultants do not run reports or search for customers.
dailyWorkflow.noAnswerRule: Send SMS immediately; record No answer → SMS sent; milestone is complete unless the customer responds.
dailyWorkflow.noShowRule: Make one follow-up only; if still no response, record the milestone and continue the cycle.

concernControl.rule: A concern remains open until a communicated outcome is resolved.
concernControl.requiredBehaviour: Communication, classification, assessment, ownership and closure are mandatory; the issue need not be TerraWest's fault and the remedy need not be free.
concernControl.qualityRoute: Recurring issues route to evidence-led DN04 Workshop / DN05 Quality review without unsupported fitter or supplier attribution.

successMeasures.outcome: Customers return as their vehicle, destinations and requirements evolve.
Issues are caught earlier and repeated causes are designed out.
Required contacts and checks occur without owner chasing.

exceptions.title: The customer handout still promises the v1.0 journey
exceptions.detail: TerraWest_After-Care_Customer_Handout_v1.0 promises a 24-hour check, a 3-month call and a 36-month Build Health Check. v1.1 moves first contact to 72 hours, removes the 3-month call and downgrades 24-36 months to ambient marketing. Any handout already given to a customer is a promise TWOS will not schedule. Reissue the handout against v1.1, or restore the 3-month call to v1.1, before the programme's automated obligations go live.
